bb.name: Plannotator
bb.description: Review workspace documents, annotate them, and send feedback to native BB conversations.

scripts.build: bun run build:styles && bun run build:assets && bun run build:isolated && bb plugin build
scripts.build:worker: bun build document-worker.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile document-worker.generated.txt
scripts.build:mermaid: bun build mermaid-sandbox-entry.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile mermaid-sandbox.generated.txt
scripts.build:assets: bun run build:worker && bun run build:mermaid
